crossRefs.note: Give thanks to Yahweh with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.
Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.
The mirth of tambourines ceases. The sound of those who rejoice ends. The joy of the harp ceases.
I will cause the noise of your songs to cease. The sound of your harps won’t be heard any more.
I will turn your feasts into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation; and I will make you wear sackcloth on all…
The voice of harpists, minstrels, flute players, and trumpeters will be heard no more at all in you. No craftsman, of…

translations.web: On the willows in that land, we hung up our harps.
translations.bsb: There on the willows we hung our harps,
translations.kjv: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst
translations.asv: Upon the willows in the midst thereof We hanged up our harps.
